name: agentic-rag-knowledge
description: Git hooks and workspace scripts for the Agentic RAG Knowledge Assistant

scripts.prepush: npm run lint:backend && npm run test:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: node scripts/backend.mjs ruff check app tests && node scripts/backend.mjs ruff format --check app tests
scripts.lint:backend:fix: node scripts/backend.mjs ruff check --fix app tests && node scripts/backend.mjs ruff format app tests
